Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. About the Role:
Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.
We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.
This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.
As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.
What You Will Do
• 
Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.
• 
Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.
• 
Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.
• 
Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.
• 
Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.
• 
Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.
What You Will Bring to the Role
• 
Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.
• 
A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.
• 
Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.
• 
Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.
• 
Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.
• 
Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.
This role is an existing vacancy

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our ever-evolving Marketplace and VAS Experience Team and help us unleash the potential of every business.

What You’ll Own

• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for one of the payments portal, from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous optimization.
• Define and maintain the product roadmap, aligning customer needs, business objectives, operational efficiency goals, and regulatory requirements.
• Drive the evolution of merchant and payee self-service capabilities, including payout tracking, account management, reporting, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
• Collaborate with engineering, design, risk, compliance, operations, customer support, and commercial teams to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant payout experiences.
• Manage the product backlog, define business requirements, write and review user stories, and prioritize features based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
• Leverage customer insights, usage analytics, support trends, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for innovation and experience improvements.
• Own key portal capabilities such as payout visibility, payment status tracking, notifications, dispute management, reporting, and reconciliation workflows.
• Drive portal adoption and engagement by simplifying user journeys and increasing self-service rates for merchants and operational teams.
• Partner with internal platforms, payments, and other cross functional teams to deliver seamless integrations that support domestic and cross-border payout experiences.
• Define and monitor product success metrics, including portal adoption, self-service utilization, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and payout transparency.
• Act as the subject matter expert for the experience, providing guidance to internal stakeholders and influencing the long-term product vision.
• Balance customer needs, business priorities, compliance requirements, and technical constraints to deliver measurable outcomes and strategic value.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications:

• MBA/ Master’s degree from Tier-1 Institutions.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related fields
• 7 + years of experience in digital product management 
• Experience working in a multinational organization, preferably within fintech, payments, banking or management consultancy
• Proven experience working with payment gateways, POS systems, e-commerce platforms, or acquiring banks.
• Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and product analytics platforms.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong understanding of payout ecosystems, including ACH, Faster Payments, RTP, SEPA, domestic and cross-border payment rails.
• Knowledge of payment orchestration, banking integrations, APIs, and event-driven platform architectures.
• Understanding of treasury, liquidity management, and funding models related to merchant payouts.
• Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Commercial teams.

95e91083fc949f92.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

 

We are building an elite team to drive financial insight and strategy at Stripe. The Finance & Strategy team brings understanding and predictability to Stripe’s financials, and we work together with our key business partners to accelerate long term growth for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Partner with F&S and Business Leaders to drive the long-term success of Stripe
  • Coach, mentor, and oversee a team of small analysts
  • Work cross functionally to identify important strategy questions and answer them with data
  • Build financial forecasts and targets, track performance, and understand deviations from actuals to drive strategy and operational rigor
  • Gain deep knowledge and understanding of Stripe's business performance across geographies and user segments
  • Define metrics and leading indicators of business performance and partner with the Analytics team to develop tools and dashboards to make these metrics widely accessible across Stripe

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of relevant FP&A, strategic finance, or business-finance experience with 2+ years managing a team
  • Experience owning planning and forecasting processes across headcount, operating expenses, and/or revenue.
  • Strong financial-analysis fundamentals, including budgeting and forecasting, month-end close support, and budget-versus-actual variance analysis.
  • The ability to manage and develop a small team of analysts, including setting priorities, reviewing work, coaching, and creating clear accountability.
  • Ability to retain a defined individual-contributor portfolio alongside people-management responsibilities. ~50% IC work, 50% Manager responsibilities.
  • Strong SQL and/or Python skills, with demonstrated ability to automate recurring analyses and improve finance workflows through AI-enabled tools and automation.
  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems, independently develop a point of view, and drive cross-functional projects to completion.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with a track record of acting as a trusted, objective finance partner to business leaders.
  • Experience working effectively across regions, time zones, and cross-functional teams.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in a strategic finance function at a high-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL or Python
  • Advanced knowledge of data visualization tools
